apps.name: Paruto Kids World
apps.tagline: An illustrated village where little ones learn and play with Jas, Jay and baby Joe.
apps.description: A browser-based illustrated village for children aged 2–5. Kids explore a 2D village with six zones alongside Jas, Jay and baby Joe, play learning games and draw in the Colour Workshop. It works offline, with no ads, no social feeds and no endless scrolling, and a grown-up gate keeps the parent area separate.

apps.name: Casefile Africa
apps.tagline: A 3D detective game: solve crimes and build cases that hold up in court.
apps.description: A premium, browser-based 3D investigation game. You play an investigator with a fictional federal agency: examine crime scenes, interview witnesses, send evidence to the lab and build a case that stands up in court. Case 001, The Maitama Ledger, opens at a rain-soaked murder scene in an upscale Abuja estate.

apps.name: ChurchSense
apps.tagline: Turn attendance, giving, follow-up and ministry data into clear insights and action.
apps.description: A church operations and ministry intelligence platform. ChurchSense helps churches capture attendance, track giving and follow-up, manage users and locations, generate reports and monitor ministry health. Built for pastors, administrators, service leaders and ministry teams, with role-based access, location-level reporting, dashboards, notifications, AI-powered insights and mobile-friendly workflows.
highlights: Attendance, giving and follow-up in one place

apps.name: Bidplum
apps.tagline: AI bid management: turn any tender into a compliance matrix and a winning proposal.
apps.description: Bidplum turns any tender into a compliance matrix, keeps your certificates and evidence ready, and drafts technical and commercial proposals that answer every requirement. Built Nigeria-first, with naira billing, local bid formats and tender search across World Bank, UN, AfDB and government notices, for businesses and consultants bidding across Nigeria and Africa.

apps.name: Hyperspeed Rail
apps.tagline: A concept maglev network for Nigeria on real terrain, and a game you can drive.
apps.description: A concept double-track maglev network for Nigeria: 11 lines and 54 stations drawn on real terrain in the browser, with trains running both ways every 30 minutes and a journey planner between any two stations. Drive the trains, take the daily challenge, redraw lines in build puzzles, or run the network and see whether the fares cover the costs. A concept, not an official plan; costs are benchmarks from real projects.
highlights: 11 lines and 54 stations on real terrain

apps.name: ARCLIGHT
apps.tagline: An anti-gravity racer for the browser, with every mesh and sound generated in code.
apps.description: An original anti-gravity racing game built with Three.js. Race nine circuits in either direction, six of them across Nigeria, from Lagos Lagoon and Abuja's Aso Rock to Kano's ancient city, with airbrakes, boost pads and weapons against skill-based AI. Take on the six-round Naija Cup, the daily challenge and a weekly tournament, and earn medals and liveries. Every mesh, texture and sound is generated in code.

apps.name: Repwise
apps.tagline: A fitness app for workouts, timers and nutrition that works offline, with no account.
apps.description: An offline-first fitness app you can install on any phone or desktop. Pick from 31 programs, 14 of them with no equipment, follow Coach Remy as he demonstrates every move, log workouts with rest timers and PR alerts, run interval timers, track food and water, and earn badges as you level up. Everything stays private on your device.

apps.name: Anansi: Swing City
apps.tagline: A 3D web-swinging game: swing across Lagos, London or any city you name, and switch the lights back on.
apps.description: Anansi, the West African spider trickster, is now a web-slinger, and Dr. Blackout has cut the city's power. Swing through an endless 3D city, starting in Lagos from Lagos Island over the Third Mainland Bridge to Eko Atlantic, smash drones, bounce on danfos and grab power cells until the skyline shouts UP NEPA! Choose Lagos, Abuja, Accra, Cape Town, London, New York or Dubai, or type any city's name, and hear local slang from the bus conductors to the rescued crowds. Missions, web-zips and a city passport keep every run fresh, and Swing City Lite, a 2D version, runs on older phones and slow connections.
highlights: Seven cities with local slang, or type your own
Missions, web-zip dashes and a city passport
